urn:plantdocs:gfps-165-solenoid-valve:so.text: (felirat nélkül) (figure): Cover photo of the solenoid valve: a black solenoid coil with an angled cable plug on top of a white intermediate part and a grey plastic valve body with union nut connections on both sides. Answers only what the valve looks like from outside; it contains no technical data.

(felirat nélkül) (figure): Image of the pressure-temperature chart for PVC (P [bar] over T [°C]); the extracted labels are only the axis tick values and the legend entry 'PVC'. Answers nothing on its own; see gfps-165-solenoid-valve/fig-3.1/chart-1

(felirat nélkül) (figure): Sectional drawing of the solenoid valve with numbered callouts 1-9 pointing to the coil housing, diaphragms, O-rings, cover, insert (sleeve) and housing; the part names are in a legend printed next to the drawing on the page. Use it to find which internal part of the valve a callout number marks and where it sits (coil on top, diaphragm stage, valve body with union connections).

(felirat nélkül) (figure): Pneumatic/hydraulic circuit symbol of the valve: a 2/2-way valve with solenoid actuation and spring return, ports 1 (P) and 2 (A), shown closed in the rest position. Use it to find the switching symbol and port designations (1 (P), 2 (A)) of circuit function A.

(felirat nélkül) (figure): Dimension drawing of the valve in side and front view with letter dimensions d, DN, H, H1, H2, H3, H4, L, L1, L2, L4, L5 and z, plus two views of the cable plug with printed dimensions 35,7 / 35.7, Ø 19, ca. 51, 29.2, 1.5, 3.5 and thread M3. Use it to find what each dimension letter of the dimension table measures, and the printed sizes of the cable plug.

(felirat nélkül) (figure): Small product photo of the solenoid valve (black coil with cable plug on a grey plastic body with union connections), printed beside the first ordering table on the Dimensions and Ordering page. Answers only what the valve looks like; it contains no technical data.

(felirat nélkül) (figure): Small product photo of the solenoid valve (black coil with cable plug on a grey plastic body with union connections), printed beside the second ordering table on the Dimensions and Ordering page. Answers only what the valve looks like; it contains no technical data.

(felirat nélkül) (figure): Small product photo of the solenoid valve (black coil with cable plug on a grey plastic body with union connections), printed beside the third ordering table on the Dimensions and Ordering page. Answers only what the valve looks like; it contains no technical data.

(felirat nélkül) (figure): Small exploded view of the valve with two callouts: 1 marks the coil assembly with its screws, 2 marks the diaphragms, O-rings and body-side small parts; printed beside the coil set table. Use it to find which parts belong to spare-part set 1 (coil) and set 2 (wear parts) of the spare-part tables.

(felirat nélkül) (figure): Small exploded view of the valve with two callouts: 1 marks the coil assembly with its screws, 2 marks the diaphragms, O-rings and body-side small parts; printed beside the wear part set table. Use it to find which parts belong to spare-part set 1 (coil) and set 2 (wear parts) of the spare-part tables.
(fejezetcím nélkül) (text_section): Only the manufacturer logo text '+GF+' from the cover page. Answers nothing on its own; see gfps-165-solenoid-valve/section-4

Spare parts (text_section): Spare parts chapter heading with two pointers: further accessory information in the online product catalog at www.gfps.com, and mobile apps/online configuration and calculation tools at www.gfps.com/tools. Answers only where to find further accessory information and online tools; the spare-part codes are in gfps-165-solenoid-valve/table-azure-7 and table-azure-8.

Quick navigation (text_section): Quick navigation list of the datasheet's chapters: Technical data, Product description, Installation notes, Dimensions and Ordering, Spare parts. Answers which chapters the datasheet contains; it holds no technical data.

Switching time (text_section): Note defining the switching time measurement: measured at the valve outlet at 6 bar and +20 ℃, opening as pressure build-up 0% to 90%, closing as 100% to 10%. Use it to find the test conditions behind the switching times in gfps-165-solenoid-valve/table-azure-2.

Pressure-temperature diagrams (text_section): Heading and legend of the pressure-temperature diagram: material PVC, T = temperature (°C, ºF), P = permissible pressure (bar, psi). Answers what the axis symbols T and P of the pressure-temperature chart mean; for values see gfps-165-solenoid-valve/fig-3.1/chart-1.

Switching functions (text_section): Heading and caption of the switching function: circuit function A, a 2/2-way valve FC (fail safe to close). Use it to find the valve's switching function and fail-safe position (FC, fail safe to close); the symbol is gfps-165-solenoid-valve/fig-3.3.
Switching time (table): Small table of valve switching times in ms: open 100 - 800 ms, close 1'000 - 4'000 ms. Use it to find the opening and closing switching time range of the valve.

Maintenance notes (text_section): Maintenance notes: maintenance only by authorized specialists, secure against unintentional operation, controlled restart afterwards, and a warning that installation and maintenance must follow the installation manual (supplied with the product and online at www.gfps.com/is-manuals-valves). Use it to find the maintenance precautions and where the installation manual is available.

Installation notes (text_section): Bulleted installation safety notes: depressurise and vent pipes, switch off and secure power, observe electrical safety regulations, keep away from flammable materials and do not touch with bare hands, risk of injury with AC valves, assembly only by authorized specialists. Use it to find the safety precautions to follow when installing or removing the valve.

Coil set (1) for solenoid valve type 165 (table): Spare-part ordering table for coil set (1) of solenoid valve type 165: EPDM and FKM order codes (198 808 029 - 034) for the 24V DC, 230V AC and 110V AC coil voltages. Use it to find the EPDM or FKM order code of the coil set for a given supply voltage.

Type 165 2/2-way Solenoid Valve (text_section): Product introduction of the Type 165 2/2-way solenoid valve: applications (shut-off, dosing and flow control in water treatment, chemical processing, microelectronics, medical and analytical use), the required minimum differential pressure of 0.5 bar, and feature bullets (servo-controlled diaphragm valve, low power consumption, fast switching, epoxy-molded coils, media-separated metal-free PVC housing up to DN50, manual override). Use it to find what the valve is for, its main design features and the minimum differential pressure needed to switch it.

Electrical connection (text_section): Electrical connection instructions: use voltage and current type from the type plate, voltage tolerance ± 10 %, connection via cable plug with protection rating IP65, cable 3 × 0.75 mm2 with flat pin terminal as ground, plug insert rotatable by 4 x 90°, tightening torque of the plug attachment 1 Nm. Use it to find the cable cross-section, plug orientation options and tightening torque for wiring the valve.

Wear part set (2) for solenoid valve type 165 (table): Spare-part ordering table for wear part set (2) of solenoid valve type 165: EPDM and FKM order codes (198 808 035 - 040) for the DN ranges 15 - 20, 25 - 32 and 40 - 50 mm (pipe d 20 - 25, 32 - 40, 50 - 63 mm). Use it to find the EPDM or FKM order code of the wear part set for a given DN range.

Pressure-temperature diagrams, PVC (chart): Pressure-temperature chart for the PVC version: a single PVC curve of permissible pressure (bar) against temperature (°C); the curve is flat at 6 bar from 0 to 40 °C, falls linearly between 40 and 50 °C and ends with a vertical drop at 50 °C. Use it to find the permissible operating pressure of the PVC valve at a given media temperature.

Specifications (table): General technical specification list of the valve as parameter-value pairs: nominal diameter DN15 - DN50, PVC housing, EPDM/FKM gasket material and the media each suits, media and ambient temperature ranges for the PVC housing, viscosity, flow media, supply voltages (24V DC, 230V and 115V 50Hz/60Hz), voltage tolerance, operating mode, electrical connection, IP65 protection rating, coil insulation class H, mounting position and CE approval. Use it to find the valve's general material, temperature, electrical, protection and approval specifications.

Solenoid valve type 165 PVC-U straight-through valve 2/2-way/110V 50Hz/60Hz (table): Ordering table for the 110V 50Hz/60Hz PVC-U straight-through 2/2-way solenoid valve type 165 for DN 15 - 50 mm, with d, size in inch, PN 6 bar, kv-value (l/min) and EPDM and FKM order codes (199 165 04x / 03x); FKM codes exist only for DN 15, 20 and 25. Use it to find the EPDM or FKM order code, size, PN and kv-value of the 110V 50Hz/60Hz valve version for a given DN.

Dimensions and Ordering (text_section): Only the chapter heading 'Dimensions and Ordering' (plus footer logo text '+GF+'), with no content of its own. Answers nothing on its own; see gfps-165-solenoid-valve/table-azure-3

Solenoid valve type 165 PVC-U straight-through valve 2/2-way/24V DC (table): Ordering table for the 24V DC PVC-U straight-through 2/2-way solenoid valve type 165 for DN 15 - 50 mm, with d, size in inch, PN 6 bar, kv-value (l/min) and EPDM (199 165 02x) and FKM (199 165 07x) order codes for every size. Use it to find the EPDM or FKM order code, size, PN and kv-value of the 24V DC valve version for a given DN.

Kv 100 values (table): Per nominal diameter (15, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50 mm) table of mode of operation (A), Kv value for water in l/min, pressure range in bar (0.5 - 6) and electrical power consumption at inrush (AC VA, DC W) and in operation (AC VA/W, DC W); two footnotes define the Kv measurement (+20 ℃, 1 bar at valve inlet, free outlet) and state that pressures are gauge pressure. Use it to find the Kv flow value, pressure range and inrush/operating power consumption for a given nominal diameter.

Solenoid valve type 165 PVC-U straight-through valve 2/2-way/230V 50Hz/60Hz (table): Two tables merged by Azure: (1) the dimension table for DN 15 - 50 mm giving d, H, H1, H2, H3, H4, L1, L4, L5, z, L and L2 in mm, and (2) the ordering table for the 230V 50Hz/60Hz PVC-U straight-through 2/2-way valve with d, size in inch, PN 6 bar, kv-value (l/min) and EPDM and FKM order codes (199 165 0xx); the DN 40 row has no FKM code. Use it to find the installation dimensions (letters as in the dimension drawing gfps-165-solenoid-valve/fig-5.1) for a DN, and the EPDM/FKM order code of the 230V 50Hz/60Hz valve version.
